checks: The least active index is Borel by finiteness and continuity. Conditional affinity holds for all finitely many affine pieces on one common full-measure set.
For each active affine piece, its expected value equals its value at the source, which equals L at the source. Subtracting the target expectation gives the row gap with a nonnegative integrand.

Zero total gap implies zero row gap almost everywhere. Applying the same row identity to each active piece proves simultaneous concentration in every corresponding closed cell. Conversely concentration makes the integral vanish.

The density formula follows by substituting the actual source marginal, with no swap of source and target. Conditioning gives the same conclusion only where the conditioned marginals and physical martingale identity hold.
The frozen source locators e6ba532e542af929 §§7–8 retain the exact scalar gap. The result does not infer its vanishing from generic convex order.

overlap.comparison: The accepted projective row lemma derives active-cell concentration for finite prescribed rows assuming their L expectation already equals the marked value, with original-volume marginal constraints. The reviewed identity gives the exact gap and zero equivalence for a general physical martingale, including conditional surface laws.
The accepted result gives existence and equivalence of abstract martingale couplings and convex order. It does not identify contact cells or the explicit finite-minimum dissipation.

readability: The two marginals are physical measures. The contact gap is tested on the actual conditional rows.
review_method: Independent cold proof read of frozen bytes, source locator audit, comparison to accepted and same-batch predecessors, and direct checks of the derivations.
summary: The affine-contact integral is the exact Jensen dissipation for the prescribed physical martingale. Its zero criterion holds simultaneously for all active planes at almost every source.
